svg.title: Does committed truth already own this live unit?
svg.desc: A live unit is suppressed only with provable committed ownership. Otherwise it survives and is ordered. Tool output yields only to a committed result, never to the tool call alone.

Arrow: read its label in the arrow direction. Cylinder: stored data. Diamond: a check.
